summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) for a shelf takedown. DeFi Development Corp. (issuer) established an at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution program with R.F. Lafferty to sell up to $200,000,000 of its common stock from time to time. The filing describes standard terms: sales at prevailing market prices, a 0.75% commission, settlement on T+1, and no escrow arrangement. The closing price on April 30, 2026, was $4.39. This is an ordinary equity shelf drawdown, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
